author: Rcovarru84
quote: Overwhelming screen load times and so full of bugs. Very disappointed, was expecting something better. Guess Rockstar can afford to pay for mediocre media reviews but yet won’t invest in their actual game development and environment

author: Rcovarru84
quote: Such a great game! I didn’t play the original but on this remake version, I’m truly enjoying the pace and game mechanics a lot! I ended up getting me a playable Ocarina just so I could learn the songs! The music, story and game environment are out of this world! Totally recommend!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Rcovarru84
quote: Truly amazing game for this saga. It has everything in one game! Lots of action, horror , puzzles, gun scaling system and even character  scaling.. It has surprisingly exceeded my expectations! Totally recommend!!
